note: Admission review only. hold rows need a relocated anchor before they can be promoted; they are excluded from the batch apply and applied one by one via promote_candidate.py.

rows.reason: Located hunk is the removed domSchema.securityContext(element.name, attr.name, true) call in ingestElementBindings; the cited refactor replaces it with namespace-aware validation, which is the advisory's namespaced-attribute bypass.

Proposal anchored the refactor-deleted normalizeNgContentSelect helper. The security change is the SCRIPT_ELEMENTS set replacing nodeName == SCRIPT_ELEMENT in preparseElement (frozen line 51). Relocate to template_preparser.ts preparseElement 51-52.

Located hunk is the removed object assignment newChildren[grandChildOutlet] = grandChild in squashSegmentGroup, the numeric-key dense-allocation sink the advisory describes; the fix switches these maps to Map.

Proposal anchored an unrelated i18n commit of the same 7-commit series. The security change is ingestHostBinding deriving SecurityContext from input.componentSelector; relocate to packages/compiler/src/template/pipeline/src/ingest.ts ingestHostBinding 104-113.

Proposal anchored the i18n commit fc0e50a2 in the same alias cluster. The XSRF fix commits (0659d11c/20474d3f/933ce817) change xsrfInterceptorFn's absolute-URL skip. Relocate to packages/common/http/src/xsrf.ts xsrfInterceptorFn 91-97 (frozen 19.2.15 uses lcUrl.startsWith('http://'/'https://'), which also misses protocol-relative and WHATWG-normalized URLs).
Located hunk is sortAndConcatParams, whose getAll(k) comma join is the cache-key ambiguity in the advisory; the fix distinguishes repeated params.
Located span is getUrlSanitizer's hardcoded src/href tag lists; the fix adds xlink:href on script and hoists the sets, which is the SVG script attribute sanitization gap.
Located span is addCreateAttribute, which the i18n fix removes so ICU script attributes go through the normal sanitizer path; matches the advisory.

Proposal anchored the type-widening of newHeaders (HeadersInit), a cosmetic change in the same commit. The security change is newRequestWithMetadata (packages/service-worker/worker/src/assets.ts), which now strips Authorization/Proxy-Authorization/Cookie on cross-origin redirects. Relocate to assets.ts 514-516.

Proposal anchored the INITIAL_CONFIG reformat in createServerPlatform, which is cosmetic. The security change adds validateAllowedHosts at the renderModule/renderApplication entry points; relocate to packages/platform-server/src/utils.ts renderModule 275-276, where options.url is passed in without host validation.
Located line is the script?.textContent check in retrieveTransferredState, the DOM-clobbering read the fix hardens; matches the advisory.

Proposal anchored the deleted iframe helper (downstream cleanup). The root cause is SECURITY_SCHEMA's URL context list, which lacks the MathML href/xlink:href and a|xlink:href entries the fix adds; relocate to packages/compiler/src/schema/dom_security_schema.ts SECURITY_SCHEMA 33-52.

Located line is parseDocument(config.document, config.url) in _document(), which the fix replaces with parseUrl(config.url, 'http://localhost').href; that is the URL parser differential the advisory describes.

relocated_rows.reason: Both removed lines of the fix hunk ('} else if (nodeName == SCRIPT_ELEMENT) {' and 'type = PreparsedElementType.SCRIPT;') are present verbatim at the relocated anchor; the proposal had matched the refactor-deleted normalizeNgContentSelect helper.

The fix removes both calcPossibleSecurityContexts(input.componentSelector, ...) calls in ingestHostBinding; the property-branch call is present verbatim at the frozen anchor. The i18n anchor came from an unrelated commit of the 7-commit series.

Frozen 19.2.15 skips the XSRF header only for urls starting with http:// or https://; protocol-relative and WHATWG-normalized urls bypass that check. The cited 20/21/22 fix commits replace ABSOLUTE_URL_REGEX with an origin comparison, whose pre-image is absent from this branch, so the equivalent vulnerable check is the anchor.

The adapter.ts change only widens a parameter type to HeadersInit (cosmetic). The security change strips Authorization/Proxy-Authorization/Cookie on cross-origin redirects in newRequestWithMetadata; the frozen function preserves all headers unconditionally.

The createServerPlatform change is an INITIAL_CONFIG reformat. The fix adds validateAllowedHosts(url, allowedHosts) at the renderApplication/renderModule entry points where options.url is forwarded to the platform; renderApplication is used because renderModule<T> has a generic parameter the tool cannot match.

The deleted iframe helper is downstream cleanup. The root cause is the URL registration list in SECURITY_SCHEMA, which lacks a|xlink:href and the MathML href/xlink:href entries the fix adds (plus the ATTRIBUTE_NO_BINDING block for SVG animation attributeName).

apply_note: 7 rows admitted in the batch (--review --apply); the 6 hold rows were relocated (see relocated_rows, all verdict admit) and applied one by one with promote_candidate.py --apply. All 13 angular rows are now in the Ground Truth.
